steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix together **3 cups oats**, **1 cup chopped almonds**, **½ cup sunflower seed**, **½ cup pumpkin seed** (or other nut, such as pecan) and **½ Tbsp wheat germ** (if you have it).

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.body: In another bowl, mix **½ Tbsp cinnamon**, **¼ tsp salt**, **2 Tbsp oil or butter** and **½ cup sugar** (honey, syrup, or brown sugar).

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Pour over dry ingredients and mix together. Pour into sheet pans.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 30–45 minutes at 325°F, stirring every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add the fruit
steps.body: Remove from oven and add **1 cup dried fruit**.
